Scope: A practical 2026 progression path for PvE grinding, including crystals, artifacts/lightstones, reforms, alchemy stones, consumables, pets, fairy, journals and spot-specific tuning.
Important: This guide separates realistic progression from theoretical DEC best-in-slot. You do not need DEC everything to grind endgame zones efficiently.

The theoretical combat-gear ceiling is DEC Sovereign weapons, DEC Edana Defense Gear and DEC Ekleta/Apeiron accessories, plus the strongest applicable crystals, artifact reforms, amplified lightstones, reforge stones and combined alchemy stone. Treat that as a horizon, not a shopping list.

Bottom line: Your grind efficiency is a complete build problem. Weapons and sheet AP matter, but crystals, artifacts, resistance, species damage, hit rate, buffs, pets and rotation can easily decide whether an expensive enhancement actually improves trash per hour.

2026 shortcut: Check your available Hyperboost and Olvia Academy rewards before buying intermediate gear. Current catch-up paths can accelerate Blackstar, Sovereign and Slumbering Origin acquisition, so most active PvE accounts now start their real planning at the Hyperboost / midgame stage rather than a manual Tuvala grind.
C10 / C20 means Caphras level 10 / 20. Base means unenhanced within that gear family.

Hyperboost and Olvia Academy rewards commonly hand new and returning 2026 accounts Blackstar, Slumbering Origin and PEN Kharazad support directly, so this guide treats Season / PEN Tuvala as a quick automatic on-ramp rather than the main event.

Tuvala is replaced by Blackstar through acquisition or rewards, not by ordinary Tuvala enhancement; most 2026 accounts receive Blackstar directly from Hyperboost rather than grinding PEN Tuvala first. Kzarka / Offin and Dandelion remain optional boss-weapon bridges for players who skip Blackstar rewards.

Match the equipment slot for all weapon ingredients. Main-hand and awakening recipes cannot be mixed. Craft at the Bonghwang / Phoenix Statue on Mount Ahshi, and remove applicable heart reforms first.
Shai's awakening uses the Artina Sol path instead of a normal Sovereign awakening weapon.

PEN Tuvala can enter Jetina's reformable TET boss-gear route, then progress to PEN boss gear, which is the standard crafting input for Slumbering Origin at C10. Many 2026 accounts skip this manual grind because Hyperboost rewards hand out boss armor or Slumbering Origin pieces directly.
PEN Blackstar armor is an alternative crafting input where supported. Keep the damage-reduction or evasion variant appropriate to your build for gloves and shoes.

Complete the Edana crafting prerequisite questline. The crafting quest is weekly: one type per week, resetting Thursday at 00:00 UTC (BDO's daily-reset time zone for PC NA/EU, not your local clock). TET Slumbering Origin is a valid entry point; a PEN Slumbering Origin conversion is an alternative, not a prerequisite.
Existing Capotia or other suitable AP accessories can also bridge the gap toward Kharazad; a full enhanced Deboreka set is not mandatory before converting.
Manufacture with 50 Essence of Dawn + 300 Magical Shards -> base Kharazad
Exchange -> PEN Kharazad of the same slot
Exchange -> NOV Kharazad of the same slot
Exchange -> base Ekleta of the same slot
Exchange -> TET Ekleta of the same slot

Deboreka exchanges are handled through Clorince in Velia; remove accessory reforms before handing over the Deboreka. Kharazad itself uses Essence of Dawn through NOV and Dawn Black Stones for DEC, and its enhancement does not require duplicate accessories.

Apeiron entry: acquire it directly or craft it from Inner Edania materials. Ekleta entry: convert NOV or DEC Kharazad. Compare converting your current Kharazad against buying or building Apeiron before committing; they are alternatives, and Ekleta does not need to be replaced by Apeiron.
Starter artifacts are replaced by Kabua's; they are not ingredients that enhance into it. Kabua's then uses a reform item to become the Heralding version.
Heating: 100 Herald's Crystals + 100 Sharp Black Crystal Shards + 100 Magical Shards + 200 Magical Lightstone Crystals
Creates a Flawless Herald's Crystal. Reform one Kabua's Artifact with it.

Added per reformed Kabua: +3 Extra AP Against Monsters, +5 Monster Damage Reduction and +250 Max HP, on top of the original artifact's effects. For two reforms, double the listed materials and added effects.

Defensive branch: Dehkia's Artifact - All Damage Reduction / All Evasion converts to a matching Dehkia's Heralding Artifact. These are alternatives for a defensive build, not the mandatory next step after Kabua's.
